claims.claim: Identity, dimensions and rigid construction match the request.
claims.evidence: request.md asks for decor/phone, class prop, rigid, 0.13 x 0.19 x 0.024 m. asset/provenance.json identifies decor/phone and prop; asset/asset.json declares rigid. asset/model.urdf has one body link and no joints. probes/01_settle.out reports mesh bounds [-0.065, -0.095, 0.00000002] to [0.065, 0.095, 0.02400002] m, matching the requested dimensions. All four renders show the expected simple neutral whitebox slab.

claims.claim: The collision box follows the visible body without blocking openings or omitting parts.
claims.evidence: renders/front.png, side.png, top.png and iso.png show one solid rounded rectangular slab with no cavities or separate parts. readings.json collision_boxes[0] and asset/model.urdf define phone as a 0.13 x 0.19 x 0.024 m box, matching mesh bounds in probes/01_settle.out. The box conservatively fills only the edge bevels, an acceptable simplification of this whitebox prop.

claims.claim: Joint travel, attachment and interpenetration checks pass as not applicable.
claims.evidence: readings.json joints is empty; asset/model.urdf has one link and one collision box. probes/01_settle.out reports joints {} and overlaps [].

claims.claim: Handle grasp and pull checks pass as not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no handles, readings.json handles is empty, and there are no moving parts.

claims.claim: Place-target landing checks pass as not applicable.
claims.evidence: request.md requires no place targets and readings.json place_targets is empty.

claims.claim: The free rigid object settles on the ground and stays upright.
claims.evidence: probes/01_settle.py uses Probe('asset', fixed=False). probes/01_settle.out records identity rotation and body pose [0, 0, 0.01197] m after cumulative 30, 150 and 300 frames (1, 5 and 10 seconds), with negligible horizontal drift. Each sample has four ground contacts of 0.581 N, totaling 2.324 N, consistent with the declared 0.237 kg mass. The helper reports an initially body-centred live pose at z=0.012 and derived box bounds offset above the contacting ground; the actual contacts and unchanged rotation establish support and stability independently of those derived bounds.
